'''Gotarites''' were a mole-like [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. They had pink skin, green eyes, a pair of powerful incisors,<ref name="The Official Guide" /> low-light vision, and an excellent sense of smell.<ref name="Vandor">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]''</ref> [[Fugas Fandita]], who was present at [[the Lodge]] on [[Vandor]], was a member of this species.<ref name="The Official Guide" /> [[Filias]] and [[Soont Madas]] were two prospector and inventor brothers on [[Koboh]] who were Gotarites as well.
